content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-75. - I.F.C. Section 904.13, Domestic cooking systems.
content.summary:
Section 904.13. Domestic cooking systems
is hereby amended by adding item number four (4.) as follows:
"4. In Group R-4 occupancies where domestic cooking facilities are installed in accordance
                  with Section 407.2.3 of the
International Building Code.
"
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-20…
